skill.name: stream-chain
skill.description: Guide Claude Flow stream-chain workflows for multi-step code, data, and agent pipeline tasks.
skill.summary: Chain prompts so each step uses previous output for structured multi-agent workflows.

security_audit.summary: All 87 static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code spans and fenced examples. No prompt injection attempt, hidden executable code, or malicious data exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples can be misread as automatic execution instructions.
remediation.suggestion: State that examples should be reviewed and run only with user approval in a prepared Claude Flow environment.

content.value_statement: Complex AI work often loses context between steps. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code chain outputs through structured workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains custom stream-chain run syntax and prompt ordering.
Documents predefined analysis, refactor, test, and optimize pipelines.
Shows how previous step output becomes context for later steps.
Provides examples for code review, migration, data processing, and QA workflows.
Describes timeout, verbose, and debug options for pipeline execution.
Covers reusable pipeline definitions in Claude Flow configuration.
limitations: Requires a working Claude Flow environment outside the skill file.
Does not implement the stream-chain command or install dependencies.
Workflow quality depends on prompt clarity and step order.
Long chains can hit timeout, context, or downstream agent limits.

use_cases.title: Review a New Codebase
use_cases.description: Run sequential analysis, issue discovery, and recommendation steps for faster onboarding.

use_cases.title: Create Repeatable Quality Pipelines
use_cases.description: Define analysis, refactor, test, and optimization flows that teams can reuse.

use_cases.title: Stage Data Transformation Work
use_cases.description: Break extraction, normalization, validation, and reporting into ordered agent tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Improvement Chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Use stream-chain to analyze my project, identify three improvements, and create a prioritized action plan. Keep each step clear.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Test Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a stream-chain workflow that reviews test coverage, designs missing tests, and drafts implementation notes for the highest-risk areas.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reusable Security Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define a reusable stream-chain pipeline for security review. Include prompts, timeout guidance, severity sorting, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Migration Chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an advanced stream-chain workflow for migrating a legacy service. Include dependency analysis, staged refactoring, validation, rollback, and documentation.

output_examples.input: Analyze a service and propose improvements.
output: A chain starts with structure analysis and component mapping.
The next step ranks code quality and architecture issues.
The final step produces a prioritized improvement plan.

output_examples.output: The skill outlines staged prompts for vulnerability discovery, severity grouping, remediation planning, and security test creation.
The result is an ordered plan for dependency review, migration steps, compatibility checks, rollback planning, and documentation.

best_practices: Use narrow prompts that name the target files, system, or workflow.
Place review and verification steps after generation or refactoring steps.
Adjust timeouts for analysis, implementation, and long migration chains.
anti_patterns: Do not chain vague prompts that leave the next agent without context.
Do not include secrets or private credentials in chained prompts.
Do not skip validation after generated code or migration output.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps plan and run sequential Claude Flow workflows where each step uses the previous output.

faq.question: Does it include executable code?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a Markdown guide for using stream-chain commands and workflow patterns.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can I create custom pipelines?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes custom prompt chains and reusable pipeline definitions for Claude Flow configuration.

faq.question: Is it only for code projects?
faq.answer: No. The examples include code workflows, data transformation, documentation, QA, and migration planning.

faq.question: What should I review before running a chain?
faq.answer: Review prompts, command arguments, timeouts, and any sensitive data that could pass between steps.
